name: Walker Farms
description: A newly built barn venue in Lindon whose design draws on historic agricultural architecture, with a modern all-white, light-filled interior, bridal and groom's suites, a large kitchen, and an outdoor pavilion for ceremonies and receptions.

Features > Bridal room.wording: Bridal suite with balcony and private restroom

Features > Event coordinator.wording: Onsite hostess during the event; 60-minute coordination meeting

Features > Groom's room.wording: Groom's Dressing Room with TV and Private Restroom

Features > Outdoors.wording: Outdoor space with pavilion for ceremonies

Decor > Signs / easels.wording: Floor easels, chalkboards, card boxes, welcome signs

Decor > String / bistro lights.wording: Bistro lights and chandeliers in the pavilion

Other > Cake table.wording: Antique tables for cake, guest book and gifts

items.label: Description
items.value: A newly built barn venue in Lindon whose design draws on historic agricultural architecture, with a modern all-white, light-filled interior, bridal and groom's suites, a large kitchen, and an outdoor pavilion for ceremonies and receptions.

items.label: Style words
items.value:
Barn
Historic agricultural architecture
Modernized
All-white, light-filled

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Peak season (May-October), 10am-10pm: Mon-Wed $6,500; Thursday $7,500; Friday or Saturday $8,500
Off season (November-April), 10am-10pm: Mon-Wed $5,500; Thursday $6,000; Friday or Saturday $6,500
Every booking includes exclusive use of the property, onsite hostess, 60-minute coordination meeting, table and chair setup/takedown (3 configurations), bridal suite, groom's room, warming kitchen, AV, piano, fire pit and decor items
Last-minute booking discount for events within 60 days (contact venue)

items.label: Outdoors
items.value: Outdoor space with pavilion for ceremonies

items.label: The Barn (indoor)
items.value: Setting: indoor · Furniture: 24 wood farm tables (36x90), 3 bistro tables, 150 bentwood chairs, 6 padded benches, 5 couches

items.label: Pavilion / outdoor space
items.value: Setting: outdoor · Furniture: 12 Oktoberfest tables, 18 60-inch round tables, 150 padded folding chairs, 24 benches · Lighting: bistro lights, golden chandeliers

items.label: Bridal room
items.value: Bridal suite with balcony and private restroom

items.value: Groom's Dressing Room with TV and Private Restroom

items.label: Included items
items.value:
24 wood farm tables and 3 adjustable bistro tables (indoor)
150 bentwood chairs, 6 vintage padded benches, 5 couches (indoor)
12 Oktoberfest tables and 18 60" round tables (outdoor)

Bistro lights and golden chandeliers in the pavilion
Drink dispensers, serving platters, charcuterie boards, cake stands
Yamaha grand player piano
Large outdoor gas fire pit
Antique tables for cake, guest book, gifts and pictures

60-minute coordination meeting included
Event planners available (cost not stated)

Venue sets up and takes down tables and chairs

Microphones

items.label: Signs / easels

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Grand outdoor pavilion
Use of barn and gardens for bridal and engagement photos (2 hours, outside the rental date, included)

items.label: Includes
items.value: Exclusive use 10am-10pm; Onsite hostess; 60-minute coordination meeting; Setup and takedown of tables and chairs (3 configurations, no fee for ceremony or luncheon/dinner); Bridal suite with balcony and private restroom; Groom's dressing room with TV and private restroom; Warming kitchen with drink dispensers, platters, charcuterie boards, cake stands; 60-inch TV and video equipment; Surround sound system; Microphones; Yamaha grand player piano; Outdoor gas fire pit; Antique cake/guest book/gift tables; Floor easels, chalkboards, card boxes, baskets, welcome signs; 2-hour bridal/engagement photo session on another date

items.label: Cake table
items.value: Antique tables for cake, guest book and gifts

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Own vendors allowed (no fee)
Family and friends may provide services
Preferred vendor list available

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
No alcohol
No smoking
Setup and cleanup must occur within reserved time
All events must end by 10pm

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Each booking includes private, full-day use of the entire property
Prices shown are 2026 calendar rates
